title: 6. Market Intermediaries Regulated by SEBI (Often Asked)

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: SEBI oversees key trading intermediaries including Stock Brokers and Sub-brokers.
Financial management and advisory entities such as Merchant Bankers, Portfolio Managers, and Investment Advisers fall under SEBI's regulatory scope.
Market infrastructure entities like Depositories and Participants are regulated by SEBI.
Credit Rating Agencies operating in capital markets are registered and monitored by SEBI.
Exams frequently ask to identify which regulatory body (SEBI vs RBI vs IRDAI) governs specific entities like Credit Rating Agencies or Merchant Bankers.
Remember that both Depositories and Depositories Participants are regulated under SEBI regulations.
Distinguish between Investment Advisers and Portfolio Managers regarding their regulatory framework under SEBI.
